scope: Proposition 4.4 of the manuscript “An infinite finitely presented simple amenable group” (preprints/An-Infinite-Finitely-Presented-Simple-Amenable-Group-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 253 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 810ff1d8e0901a21), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any finite list of smooth signals constant outside compact sets, and any finite list of flag types, the laws of the independent fields in (16) can be chosen so that, for every g ∈ K, the total variation distance between their joint law and its image under g is arbitrarily small on all sites at once. With probability tending to one as N → ∞, every bit is one wherever its signal is at least two, and zero wherever its signal is at most minus two.
